description:
Because:
- The React 404 page removed the last server-side gettext page.

This commit:
- Removes the i18n-abide middleware, localized-render, /i18n/client.json and 404.html.
- Removes the grunt l10n tasks, their package.json scripts and the gettext dependencies.
- Deletes the gettext extract CI workflow.
- Sends fixed English from 500.js.
- Trims build.js to the steps that still have input.

Fixes FXA-14883

Co-authored-by: Lauren Zugai <lzugai@mozilla.com>
